# Tear-out without a cross-window sort group leaves no way back, silently

## Context

2026-10-07: in the installed Fleet Manager, the operator and @neo-gpt-sophie tore a tab out of the app, dropped it outside, then dragged the new window back over the app. The main app showed no drop zones. Workstation, which publishes a cross-window sort group, docked a committed popup moved over main back into it in @neo-fable's 2026-09-26 probes. The difference is configuration that nothing checks.

## The Problem

A workspace can turn tear-out on and still have no way back, and nothing says so:
- `enableDockTearOutLifecycle: true` makes `Workspace#getDockProjectionOptions` return `{enableDockTearOut: true, ...tearOutHandlers}` (`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs`). Tear-out works.
- The way back needs a cross-window sort group. `LayoutAdapter` threads `crossWindowSortGroup` into each tab zone's `sortGroup`, the key `DragCoordinator` registers zones under. The workspace composes its default cross-window `Participation` only when it publishes one (`Workspace.mjs:61`, `window/Participation.mjs:636`). Without it, a window dragged back finds no registered target, and no drop zones are painted.
- `LayoutAdapter` defaults the group to `null`. The base hook publishes none.

Fleet Manager's cockpit (`apps/agentos/view/fleet/cockpit/Container.mjs`, `VesselContainer.mjs` in neomjs/neo-agent-institution) enables the lifecycle but publishes no group. Workstation publishes one explicitly (`apps/workstation/view/VesselWorkspace.mjs`, `PopupWorkspace.mjs`). WebStudio hit the same omission on 2026-09-03; its fix added the group. #18197 closed the sibling case, a lost `enableDockTearOut`, with a throw at projection. The sort group has no such guard.

## The Fix

Make "tear-out on, no way back" impossible to ship silently. Two shapes:
1. **Guard (smallest; safe for 13.2):** at projection, when `enableDockTearOut` is on and no `crossWindowSortGroup` is published, report it once (`console.warn` naming the workspace class), so the omission shows in the first manual test. #18197's throw is the precedent for escalating later. A throw now would break every consumer that upgrades before publishing a group.
2. **Default:** when the lifecycle is on and no group is published, use a default group. Whether unrelated workspaces may then share a group is a design decision for the docking design record's §2.3 owner, not this ticket.

Recommendation: ship 1 with 13.2, and decide 2 after the cut.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A workspace projected with the tear-out lifecycle on and no `crossWindowSortGroup` reports the omission once, naming the workspace class (unit).
- [ ] A workspace that publishes a group, such as Workstation's `VesselWorkspace`, reports nothing (unit).
- [ ] Workstation's tear-out and return gestures are unchanged (existing e2e).

## Out of Scope

- Fleet Manager's own fix, publishing its group (Institution; routed to its owner).
- A default group (shape 2): decided after the cut.
